mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.backupHint: Enter one of your backup codes. Each one works only once.
mfa.expired: The time to enter the code has run out. Sign in again.
mfa.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
mfa.passkeyHint: Use your passkey to confirm it's you.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: How you sign in and where your account is open.
security.linkHelp: Two-step verification and open sessions are under Security.

sessions.title: Open sessions
sessions.help: The devices where your account is signed in. Close any you don't recognise.
sessions.closeOthersMessage: {count} sessions will be closed. Those devices go back to the sign-in page on their next request.

history.title: Sign-in history
history.help: Recent sign-ins and security changes on your account.

access.title: Access
access.closeAllMessage: The user will return to the sign-in page on all their devices.
access.unavailable: No access information is available for this user.

password.tooShort: The password is too short for the company's policy.
password.tooCommon: That password is too common: choose another one.

mfaSetup.title: Turn on two-step verification
mfaSetup.bodyCompany: {company} requires a second factor to sign in. Turn it on now to continue.
mfaSetup.body: Your company requires a second factor to sign in. Turn it on now to continue.
mfaSetup.continueHint: Once it is on, enter the ERP.
mfaSetup.checkError: It is not turned on yet. Finish the setup and try again.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.help: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN, with no password to type.
passkey.addHint: Give it a name so you can recognise it, then confirm in your device's prompt.
passkey.removeMessage: You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. Your other sessions will be closed.
passkey.here: This key belongs to this device
passkey.elsewhere: This key belongs to the web
passkey.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkey.exists: This passkey is already on your account.
passkey.requiredByPolicy: You can't remove your only passkey: your company requires a second factor.
passkey.error: The passkey operation could not be completed. Please try again.
passkey.loginFailed: Could not sign in with the passkey. Try again or use your password.
passkey.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
passkey.elsewhereDesktop: Your passkey is in the desktop app. Sign in from there or use another method.
passkey.elsewhereDevice: Your passkey belongs to another device. Sign in from that device or use another method.

email.needEmail: Enter your username or email first.
email.title: Sign in with a code
email.hint: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you.
email.linkAlso: Opening the link in the email works too.
email.sendFailed: Could not request the code. Try again.
email.desktopHint: Open the link in the email and confirm the request.

handoff.title: Finish in your browser
handoff.confirmHint: Check it matches the one you will see when approving the request.
handoff.expired: The request has expired. Start again.

emailLink.invalid: The link is not valid or has expired.
emailLink.approveTitle: Is it you trying to sign in?
emailLink.approveHint: Someone asked to sign in to Keirost with your account from this device:
emailLink.confirmHint: It must match the one on the other device.
emailLink.approve: Yes, it's me, let them in
emailLink.denied: They were not let in. You can close this tab; if it wasn't you, change your password.
emailLink.approved: You can go back to Keirost now
emailLink.approvedHint: The other device will sign in in a few seconds. You can close this tab.
emailLink.approveFailed: Could not approve the request. Try again.

sso.startFailed: Could not open the browser. Try again.
sso.desktopHint: Finish signing in in your browser and check that the code matches this one.
sso.linkedHelp: Link an external account to sign in with it without typing your password.
sso.unlinkMessage: You will no longer be able to sign in with this external account. You can link it again at any time.

errors.generic: Could not sign in with the provider. Try again.
errors.NO_ACCOUNT: There is no Keirost account for that email.
errors.EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: The provider has not verified that email, so it cannot be used to sign in.
errors.DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: The domain of that email is not allowed for this provider.
errors.STATE_INVALID: The request expired or was opened in another browser. Start again.
errors.SSO_CANCELLED: You cancelled the sign-in at the provider.
errors.SSO_FAILED: The provider could not confirm your identity. Try again.
errors.SSO_PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND: That provider is no longer available.
errors.SSO_UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the provider. Try again later.
errors.SSO_NOT_CONFIGURED: Sign-in with external providers is not configured on this server.
errors.HANDOFF_INVALID: The request from the app expired. Start again.
errors.IDENTITY_IN_USE: That external account is already linked to another user.
errors.SESSION_INVALID: Your session was closed while linking the account. Sign in again and retry.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Your company does not allow signing in with this method.
errors.SSO_REQUIRED: Your company requires signing in with an external provider.
errors.TICKET_INVALID: The link expired or was already used. Start again.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

providers.title: Sign-in
providers.subtitle: External providers (Google, Microsoft or OIDC) that can be used to sign in to this installation.
providers.superuserOnly: Only a superuser can configure sign-in providers.
providers.removeMessage: "{name}" will be deleted and the accounts already using it will be unlinked. Nobody will be able to sign in with it.
providers.forbidden: Only a superuser can change providers.
providers.nameHelp: This is the button text: "Continue with …".
providers.issuerHelp: The provider's https address (the one that serves /.well-known/openid-configuration).
providers.domainsHelp: Comma separated. Empty allows any domain.
providers.trustMfaHelp: If the provider already asked for a second step, Keirost does not ask again.
providers.callbackAfterSave: Shown once the provider is saved.
providers.callbackHelp: Register it as an authorized redirect address at the provider.
